study.question: Does useful native centered auxiliary product-context transfer depend on its component parallel to the current click context cotangent, its orthogonal component, or both?
study.hypothesis: Provisional direction hypothesis: the useful centered auxiliary transfer carries representation information beyond immediate click-loss alignment, so preserving its orthogonal orientation should retain more click-AUC benefit than preserving only its parallel orientation. Existing trials establish neither this explanation nor gradient conflict. The competing explanation is that parallel direction accounts for the benefit. At a common state let H be occupied history rows, C=center_H(sum_aux G), R=center_H(G_click), P=proj_R(C), O=C-P. Apply sP*P+sO*O only to the shared auxiliary product-context edge for (sP,sO) in {+1,-1}^2. Keep click cotangent unchanged. Because P and O are orthogonal, all cells preserve ||C||_F in exact arithmetic and zero occupied-row mean. No primary-label information enters forward; click labels influence the reference through ordinary backward only.

nearest_work.difference: Read Yu et al. Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning, section2.3 and Algorithm1. PCGrad removes conflicting parameter-gradient projections in randomized task order. This study uses two-output identity autograd to reflect globally defined context-cotangent components with deterministic signs, leaves click and task-private derivatives fixed, and keeps native auxiliary edge norm. It is an attribution factorial, not PCGrad or a priority claim.

Read Du et al. Adapting Auxiliary Losses Using Gradient Similarity, section3, propositions1/2 and local-similarity limitations. Their method gates/scales shared-parameter auxiliary updates using gradient cosine. Here parallel versus orthogonal context directions are independently reflected for attribution. No convergence guarantee is transferred to sparse Adagrad, AdamW, BF16, AUC selection or this surrogate VJP.

Read cached primary benchmark section2.3, especially INFNet task-token information flow and TokenMixer forward mixing. Current architecture is inherited; only backward context transfer changes. Original INFNet/TokenFormer full papers were not available through the registry (link-only records), and no originality or source-method effectiveness claim is made.

Inspected the complete inherited standalone module and baseline_reference.py. Replace three per-task centered context VJPs by one paired click/aggregate-auxiliary VJP, then factor the centered auxiliary direction relative to click. Two replay cells measure arithmetic/graph changes before interpreting the new reflections.

study.proposed_difference: One training-only paired identity is inserted immediately after context embedding concatenation. Its primary output feeds all click context paths; its auxiliary output reaches shared embeddings only through auxiliary product correction. In its backward collect click G_click and aggregate auxiliary G, center both over mask.any occupied rows in FP32, project C onto centered click R, and independently reverse P and O. Compute the same projection in every cell; equal signs return exact representable +/-C instead of reconstructing it. No parameters/buffers, extra forward/backward passes, labels in forward, host changes, persistent diagnostics or external model I/O are added. Four standalone sources preserve private derivatives and inference operators. All new results are unmeasured.
predictions: Implementation gate: centered_replay and reversed_replay reproduce previous corresponding gradients within declared dtype tolerances and validation AUC within 0.00005; failure blocks attribution of new reflections.

Provisional orthogonal-information prediction: AUC(centered_replay)-AUC(orthogonal_reflected) exceeds AUC(centered_replay)-AUC(parallel_reflected), with at least0.0001 difference as a practical exploratory threshold, provided both reflected components have non-negligible measured energy.

Competing parallel explanation predicts the opposite contrast ordering. Both reflections harming AUC suggests both directions matter; neither harming AUC despite adequate perturbation weakens the proposed click-reference decomposition.

At a common state forward predictions, BCE, private dense gradients, primary context cotangent and buffers match across cells. Transformed auxiliary context means are zero over occupied rows, empty rows remain zero, and Frobenius norms match C within numerical tolerances.

Inferred parameter counts remain32192421 total /31793216 embedding /399205 dense; inference graph unchanged. Measure actual train cost, peak memory, examples, allocated GPU time, throughput and p50/p95 batch latency; equal graph work is not a measured equal-compute claim.
falsifiers: Adequately powered/repeated contrasts do not retain the centered auxiliary benefit over the existing click-only/blocked controls: useful auxiliary transfer remains unsupported in this setting.

With replay equivalence and adequate component energy, reversing the parallel component hurts more than reversing orthogonal: falsifies the stated orthogonal-information direction prediction and favors the competing local alignment account.
No reproducible difference from either single-component reflection despite nontrivial perturbations weakens this decomposition as the explanation of the previous sign sensitivity.

Norm/occupancy/private-gradient invariants fail, tensor gradients are nonfinite, replay drift exceeds threshold, or component energy is effectively zero: implementation or identification failure, not a scientific refutation of useful auxiliary supervision.
alternative_explanations: Projection is at the concatenated context activation, globally across occupied examples and coordinates, not in embedding-parameter or optimizer-update geometry. Repeated IDs and sparse scatter can alter norms and alignment.
P/O are recomputed from each cell's changing state. This is a dynamic training intervention, not an additive decomposition of final AUC.
Aggregate-before-centering can change floating addition order relative to previous per-task centering; both replay controls and common-state gradient checks are required.
Click context cotangent includes all click context paths and cross-example Dice derivatives. Local BCE gradient alignment does not guarantee validation AUC or convergence.
A single global projection can miss fieldwise or per-example alignment; low projection energy makes a parallel-reflection null uninformative.
Native Frobenius norms are matched at the edge; per-row norms, total click-plus-auxiliary norms, optimizer accumulators and final updates are not matched.
Single frozen-seed selection, validation reuse and multiple adaptive trials may overstate small AUC differences. Identical-seed replays are not independent replication.
Changes to primary-versus-auxiliary total gradient geometry may affect adaptive optimizer state rather than transfer of task-specific semantic information.
Official offline delayed-feedback visibility and category/brand-matched auxiliary labels limit temporal and production interpretation.

validation_plan.phase_and_access: Only propose/code/static algebra checks in this workspace; no torch, numpy, jsonschema, raw dataset, GPU training, checkpoint, validator executable or withheld interface is exposed locally. host_preflight_required: Load each standalone source on host under frozen schema. Compare module/key/shape/parameter counts, state_dict buffers, exact seeded initialization and constructor RNG against parent and sibling cells. Round-trip checkpoints. Confirm forward prediction/BCE/buffer equivalence at common state in train/eval, including empty and mixed histories, padded-value perturbations and final eval batch of odd size1.

At synthetic fixed cotangents and actual common states test paired autograd outputs. Independently obtain click-only and three auxiliary context VJPs with retained graph on host diagnostic batches; compare actual input derivative to G_click+sP*P+sO*O. Check auxiliary aggregate, all detaches/private parameters, loss zeros, task label ordering, no current labels entering forward and sparse-table gradients after repeated-ID scatter.

Test R=0, C=0, all-empty, one occupied, repeated context IDs, constant occupied cotangents, mixed empty rows, noncontiguous tensors, and R parallel/orthogonal to C; synthetic pure cases should exchange appropriately under reflections. FP32 geometric relative tolerance1e-5, zero-row absolute tolerance1e-10; BF16 cast/inherited operation tolerances at most2percent relative plus1e-8 absolute, justified by gradient scale. Record violations rather than silently relaxing thresholds.

Measure C/P/O energies, dot(C,R), cosine, zero-reference frequency, empty-row derivative, norm error and actual perturbation size at identical predeclared diagnostic training positions (initial state, after first nonzero auxiliary product derivative, quarter, half and end of pass), using only training labels/inputs; costs count. Init-zero adapters alone cannot validate a gradient contrast. No persistent diagnostic model buffers are added; use authorized host diagnostic facility if present.

Predeclared identification gate: report observed ||P||^2/||C||^2 and ||O||^2/||C||^2 weighted across sampled nonzero training states. If a component ratio is below1e-3 at all sampled nonzero states, a null for reversing that component is weak perturbation, not evidence of irrelevance. If host cannot expose these diagnostics, performance contrasts remain measured but the component-mechanism conclusion remains unresolved.

Before substantive interpretation require same-source centered_replay/reversed_replay validation AUC within0.00005 of historical corresponding cells; common-state aggregate-centering VJP rtol1e-4/atol1e-10 relative to sum of inherited per-task centered VJPs. A breach is a graph/arithmetic mismatch to investigate prospectively, not auxiliary counterevidence. Keep all scores and charged costs.
